title: PR preview scenarios
description: Test scenarios for a pull request. Each one becomes a link into the ART_MODE preview build with the described game state pre-loaded. Written for OpenAI strict structured outputs: every object has additionalProperties:false, every property is required (optional ones are nullable), and the free-form game-state patch travels as a JSON string.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the PR changes from a tester's point of view.

title.description: Short name, max ~60 characters, e.g. 'Hungry chicken, one Hen House'.

why.description: One sentence: which part of the diff this exercises and what should be observed.

route.description: Hash route to open, e.g. '/' for the farm or '/world/plaza'. Must start with '/'. Never a full URL.

fixture.description: Base farm the patch is merged over.

patch.description: A JSON object literal, as a string, holding the partial GameState deep-merged over the fixture. Example: "{\"coins\":500,\"henHouse\":{\"animals\":{\"0\":{\"awakeAt\":\"$now-2h\"}}}}". null deletes a key, arrays replace, numbers over Decimal fields become Decimals, strings like '$now-2h' become timestamps. Use "{}" for no patch.

localStorage.description: Optional JSON object literal, as a string, of localStorage keys to seed before boot. Values may use '$date' tokens for ISO dates. null when not needed.

steps.description: 2 to 6 lines: what the tester should click and what they should expect to see.
